title: It Had to Be You
description: A marriage-shy sculptor (Ginger Rogers) meets the Indian boy of her childhood dreams, now a firefighter (Cornel Wilde).

title: You Can't Run Away From It
description: A newsman (Jack Lemmon) rides a bus, hitchhikes and shares a cabin with a tycoon's (Charles Bickford) runaway daughter (June Allyson).

title: Guess Who's Coming to Dinner
description: White liberals must overcome their own latent racism when their strong-willed daughter announces her intention to marry a distinguished black physician.

title: A Man for All Seasons
description: Sir Thomas More (Paul Scofield) opposes Henry VIII's (Robert Shaw) appointing himself head of the Church of England.

title: Funny Girl
description: Ziegfeld Follies star Fanny Brice (Barbra Streisand) falls for gambler Nicky Arnstein (Omar Sharif).

title: The Ambushers
description: A secret agent (Dean Martin) saves a flying-saucer prototype and its pilot (Janice Rule) in the third of four Matt Helm movies.

title: Shockproof
description: An ex-convict (Patricia Knight) flees with her Los Angeles parole officer (Cornel Wilde) after shooting her former lover (John Baragrey).

title: 5 Against the House
description: Friends (Guy Madison, Kim Novak, Brian Keith) join a college student's scheme to rob a Reno casino for kicks.

title: The Chase
description: An escaped convict (Robert Redford) heads for his wife (Jane Fonda) and corrupt small-town Texans, who order a sheriff (Marlon Brando) to stop him.

title: A Night to Remember
description: A mystery writer and his wife find a corpse in the backyard of their Greenwich Village apartment.

title: It Happened to Jane
description: A Maine lobsterwoman (Doris Day) has her lawyer (Jack Lemmon) sue a railroad tycoon (Ernie Kovacs) over a spoiled shipment.

title: Her Husband's Affairs
description: A wacky woman (Lucille Ball) somehow gets the credit for her husband's (Franchot Tone) advertising genius.

title: Walk, Don't Run
description: A British businessman (Cary Grant) shares an apartment with a U.S. athlete (Jim Hutton) and a diplomat's fiancée (Samantha Eggar) during the Tokyo Olympics.

title: From Here to Eternity
description: While a Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor looms, an Army sergeant (Burt Lancaster), a former boxer (Montgomery Clift) and an officer's wife (Deborah Kerr) become entangled with others at an Army base on Oahu.

title: Three on a Couch

title: The Game That Kills

title: Miss Grant Takes Richmond

title: Pal Joey
description: A singer (Frank Sinatra) flirts with a chorus girl (Kim Novak) from Albuquerque after a San Francisco socialite (Rita Hayworth) buys him a nightclub.

title: Eight Iron Men
description: GIs sit in a bombed-out house with a comrade trapped outside; then one (Bonar Colleano) does something.

title: The Heroes of Telemark
description: A freedom fighter (Richard Harris) and a scientist (Kirk Douglas) sink a shipment of heavy water en route to Berlin from a Nazi factory in Norway.

title: 711 Ocean Drive
description: A telephone repairman (Edmond O'Brien) becomes the boss of a gambling syndicate he has ingeniously wired for profit.

title: Jeanne Eagels
description: A 1920s dancer/actress (Kim Novak) leaves her jealous lover (Jeff Chandler) for Broadway, Hollywood and alcoholic decline.

title: The Mouse That Roared
description: The field marshal, prime minister and grand duchess (Peter Sellers) of Fenwick declare war on the United States.

title: Phffft!
description: Being with a blonde (Kim Novak) and a bachelor makes a divorced lawyer (Jack Lemmon) and TV writer (Judy Holliday) want to be back together.

title: Gidget Grows Up
description: Gidget goes to New York, becomes a U.N. guide and meets an older man.

title: Mickey One
description: A nightclub comic (Warren Beatty) in debt to mobsters hides in Chicago at the mercy of his ego.

title: Berserk
description: Scotland Yard looks into spiking, buzz sawing and knifing at ringmaster Monica's traveling circus.

title: The Daring Young Man
description: After the military turns him down as being unfit, a man proves himself a hero by cracking a Nazi spy ring.

title: Under the Yum Yum Tree
description: A lusty landlord (Jack Lemmon) eyes a coed (Carol Lynley) who is trying to live platonically with her boyfriend (Dean Jones).

title: The Mating of Millie
description: A businesswoman (Evelyn Keyes) asks a bachelor (Glenn Ford) to help her find a husband so she can adopt an orphan.
